purpose: Synthetic baseline test fixtures for transparent instructional hypotheses, not clinical assessment.

collection_context.reading: Synthetic transcription of an isolated-word reading sample; five words, no real audio. This is a baseline probe, not a decodable story.
collection_context.writing: One synthetic independent typed draft before correction or outlining. Spelling probes below are indexed excerpts from that same draft. A fictional adult authorizes the baseline probe; ordinary support-mode dictation remains available. No handwriting, timing, or motor inference is supported.
collection_context.math: Two synthetic baseline problems before modeled instruction, with adult authorization; practice modes do not imply that tools were used in this baseline.

writing_sample.prompt: Write about a crab you saw.
writing_sample.student_response: I see a sed in the sand. My fet go dep. A gren crab can slep in a shell. I saw the crab first.
writing_sample.intended_text_for_evaluator: I see a seed in the sand. My feet go deep. A green crab can sleep in a shell. I saw the crab first.
writing_sample.authorship: Synthetic student-authored draft; evaluator reference is not an AI replacement to show the student.
organizational_observations: Adds the opening event at the end: I saw the crab first comes after the description.
writing_sample.assessment_limits: Text alone cannot establish dysgraphia or handwriting characteristics.

proposed_profile_update.policy: Only the analysis step may append dated session_log entries. Teacher-reviewed or validated observations inform later practice; diagnoses and IEP settings remain unchanged.

next_session.reading_focus: Practice hearing and reading ee in seed and feet before blending new ee words.
next_session.writing_focus: Use the student's own spoken ideas to build an outline; the student writes and revises the final sentences.

adaptation_demo.shared_objective: Explain how to find a missing quantity after taking some objects away.
adaptation_demo.instruction_format: One spoken direction with shell counters
adaptation_demo.scaffolding: Mark the starting point and count each backward move
adaptation_demo.feedback: Name careful counting before modeling one backward move
adaptation_demo.visual_or_auditory_support: Number line with shell markers and optional spoken directions

session_log_policy: Profile logs remain empty until the analysis step records dated, reviewable observations.
